definition: conceptual improving beside health movement, and why the two are not equal

settled:
Improving me splits the way I split. Four fifths of it is the conceptual map and one fifth is the physical and emotional side.

Conceptual improving has a clear absolute direction, accumulates only upward along my timeline, and lasts.

Health movement has no direction that clear, and I do not expect it to be monotonic. It washes in and out rather than piling up, and it is pinned to the present rather than carrying along the chain.

Health still matters, and it earns its place two ways. It sets how far I can move toward truth at all, and it is what lets each immediate me enjoy being alive now.

Both of those are in service of something else, where truth-movement is the thing itself. So health is weaker in purpose, ranked below truth because it is less lasting.

title: The Two Halves Of Improving Me
